description: This Java source file defines the ElevationBasicFragment class, which is an Android Fragment handling a UI with a shape that reacts visually to touch events by changing its elevation (translationZ). It sets up touch listeners to modify view elevation on touch events.

classes.name: ElevationBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that inflates a layout with a shape that changes elevation when touched.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, enabling options menu.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, finds the shape view, and sets up touch listener to change elevation on touch events.
